items.summary: Product recommendation: preserve containment-only execution this cycle. The brief supports valuable deferred opportunities across SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content, and monetization surfaces, but no new site proposal or work item is queue-ready. Evidence includes 47 open failure follow-ups, 28 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, unavailable operations/security sweeps, incomplete attribution, and only 2 proven outcomes. Continue existing repair-or-close, measurement/attribution reconciliation, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Keep financial outcomes, causal lift, and revenue impact unknown; retain deferred opportunities for reconsideration after gates clear.
